scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --log-level warn --var UPLOAD_AUTH_MODE:password
scripts.types: wrangler types worker/bindings.d.ts --env-interface CloudflareBindings --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
